notice: This is a human-supervised roadmap, NOT an executable scheduler. All statuses start todo; source specs and actual code decide acceptance. Never self-approve science or release.

tasks.title: Development foundation and DB/test scaffolding
tasks.goal: Build Next.js/FastAPI topology, disposable PostgreSQL/pgvector, Alembic and real lint/test commands.

evidence.note: Frontend build/tests and backend lint/tests verified manually.

tasks.title: Audit real curated YAML and JSON files
tasks.goal: Inventory schemas, source references, units, placeholders and licensing; document proposed import mapping without scientific approval.

tasks.title: Landing page from approved v4 spec
tasks.goal: Build functional responsive marketing surface; use labeled artwork placeholders, honest CTAs and browser checks.

tasks.title: Truthful pricing entry and navigation
tasks.goal: Provide a real pricing information route/entry without invented paid plans, trials or billing.

tasks.title: Authentication and authorized sessions
tasks.goal: Implement signup/login/logout, opaque sessions, CSRF, owner isolation and real auth tests.

tasks.title: Resumable onboarding, plots and seasons
tasks.goal: Persist user inputs and draft state; respect unknown soil values and plot-season ownership.

tasks.title: Research storage, ingestion and scientific gates
tasks.goal: Version sources and ingest validated YAML idempotently; reviewed-rule eligibility abstains on unsupported cases.

tasks.title: Plan job and immutable blueprint storage
tasks.goal: Persist idempotent plan jobs, worker outcomes, validated versioned plans and source provenance.

tasks.title: Saved-plan dashboard
tasks.goal: Render real selected plot/season plan data; truthful unavailable and stale states.

tasks.title: Plan-linked chat and non-mutating what-if
tasks.goal: Bind secure chat to plan versions; cite eligible evidence and do not mutate saved plans.

tasks.title: Activate first reviewed agronomy scope
tasks.goal: Enable only human-reviewed crop/region/method/source/rule versions with independent evidence.

tasks.title: Hardening for temporary public demo
tasks.goal: Complete security, privacy/retention, cleanup and real deployment checks before public release.
